description: Diagnostic test ordering — allergy serology, blood / clinical-chemistry panels, cytology, imaging, in-clinic instrument acquisitions — to external clinical lab (with iyashi.phlebotomyAttestation when religious-corp clinic performs venipuncture) or community center equipment. Inherits G1 (consent receipt CID mandatory) + G2 (resultDeliveryChannel must be encrypted-mst-envelope) + G4 (R2+ licensed MD physicianAttestorDid mandatory) from ADR-2605260100. R2+ phase only. Rhinitis-domain enums per ADR-2605260115 §Decision 2 (IgE) + ADR-2605260145 §Decision 3 (CT) + ADR-2605260160 §Decision 2 (rhinomanometry). General blood / chemistry enums + iyashi-internal routing target + diagnosticConsentReceipt binding added per ADR-2605281950.

orderType.description: Per ADR-2605281950: 16 general blood / clinical-chemistry / urinalysis orderType values appended (R2+ activate). Rhinitis-scoped orderType set unchanged. Excluded by N1..N11 of ADR-2605281950: genetic / DTC / NIPT / oncology markers / fertility hormones / STI / heavy-metal / forensic / employer-screen / in-vivo skin prick.

conditionContext.description: Per ADR-2605281950: 18 general (non-rhinitis) conditionContext values appended (R2+ activate). Each context is community-primary-care-scoped. Out of scope (constitutional non-goals): genetic markers, NIPT, oncology screening, fertility hormones, STI testing, forensic / employer screen — see ADR-2605281950 §D6.

consentReceiptCid.description: Mandatory (G1 + ADR-2605281950 GC). MUST resolve to an `com.etzhayyim.mitate.diagnosticConsentReceipt` record (or, for rhinitis-domain orders predating ADR-2605281950, the legacy generic encrypted consent record). Procedure-level consent, distinct from intake-level consent.

orderRoutingTarget.description: R2+ (ADR-2605281950). 'iyashi-internal' = phlebotomy by religious-corp iyashi clinic (requires linked `com.etzhayyim.iyashi.phlebotomyAttestation`); 'external-lab' = specimen drawn elsewhere or assay-only at external facility. Optional at R0/R1; required at R2+.

physicianAttestorDid.description: Mandatory (G4). Licensed MD DID attesting clinical indication. Must be in LICENSED_MD_REGISTRY (Council-attested).

scopedAntigens.description: Only for orderType = 'ige-panel-*'. WHO IUIS allergen nomenclature (e.g. 'Der-f-1', 'Fel-d-1', 'Cry-j-1').

externalLabDid.description: For orderType requiring external facility (ige-panel, ct, mri, culture). Must be in EXTERNAL_LAB_DID_REGISTRY.

internalEquipmentDid.description: For orderType using mitate community center equipment (smear / endoscopy / rhinomanometry). Must be in equipment registry (Hanami / Mimi / rhinomanometer).

resultDeliveryChannel.description: G2 mandatory. Plaintext delivery channel is prohibited.
